title: China's artificial intelligence witnesses comprehensive industrial chain breakthroughs and will accelerate the legislation of the Artificial Intelligence Law

content_html:
The global downloads of domestic large models have exceeded 10 billion times, and trillion-parameter open-source models are emerging frequently. China's artificial intelligence is experiencing a comprehensive breakthrough across the entire industry chain.

Jiang Yi, director of the Policy Research Office and spokesperson of the National Development and Reform Commission, stated at a press conference on July 31 that in the first half of this year, China's artificial intelligence has made significant progress in independent innovation. Domestic companies such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI have successively released open-source large models with parameter scales reaching "trillion-level."

Jiang Yi emphasized that in the next step, efforts will be made to balance high-quality development with high-level security, ensuring that artificial intelligence runs fast and steadily. Specifically, efforts will focus on three aspects: first, accelerating independent innovation, focusing on frontier directions such as fundamental theories of large models, training and inference efficiency, multimodal capabilities, and intelligent agents; second, emphasizing application orientation, accelerating the layout and construction of national artificial intelligence application pilot bases; third, deepening the ecosystem, vigorously cultivating intelligent derivative enterprises, and accelerating the legislative process of the Artificial Intelligence Law, striving to contribute a governance model with Chinese characteristics.

In addition, the official also pointed out that efforts will be strengthened to monitor and prevent risks in artificial intelligence, improve technical monitoring, risk early warning, and emergency response systems, and adhere to the principle that technology is led by people, used by people, and for the benefit of people, properly addressing the impact of artificial intelligence on areas such as economic operations and employment distribution.

content_html_zh:
国产大型模型全球下载量已突破百亿次，万亿参数开源模型频频涌现。 中国的人工智能正在经历全产业链的全面突破。

国家发展改革委政策研究室主任、新闻发言人姜毅7月31日在新闻发布会上表示，今年上半年，我国人工智能自主创新取得重大进展。 DeepSeek、Moonshot AI等国内公司相继发布了参数规模达到“万亿级”的开源大型模型。

蒋毅强调，下一步将努力平衡好高质量发展和高水平安全，确保人工智能又快又稳运行。 具体来说，将重点抓三个方面的工作：一是加快自主创新，聚焦大模型基础理论、训练推理效率、多模态能力、智能代理等前沿方向；二是突出应用导向，加快国家人工智能应用试点基地布局建设。三是深化生态体系，大力培育智能衍生企业，加快人工智能法立法进程，努力贡献中国特色治理模式。

此外，该负责人还指出，将加强人工智能风险监测和防范，健全技术监测、风险预警和应急处置体系，坚持科技由人主导、科技由人使用、科技造福于人，妥善应对人工智能对经济运行、就业分配等领域的影响。
